chunks: The first House set up for the people was indeed that at Bakkah, a blessing and a guidance for the worlds.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Bakkah as the first House of God?
ai.summary: This verse, known as the 'Verse of the Kaaba,' establishes the sanctity of the Bakkah (Mecca) as the primordial house of worship, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegesis as the focal point of monotheism (Tawhid) from the time of Abraham and Ishmael. It highlights the Kaaba not merely as a physical structure but as a universal symbol of divine guidance (Huda) for all humanity, reinforcing its central role in Islamic ritual and spiritual orientation.
